```{r}
#| warnings: false
#| message: false
#| output: false

# Get the nth indicator
ind <- topic_inds[i]

# get number of sexes for selected indicator
n_sex <- healthtrends:::ind_n_sex(ind, all_data)

if (area_code == "E92000001") {
  filter_areas <- area_code
} else {
  filter_areas <- c(area_code, "E92000001")
}

# England and area
ind_data <- all_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    AreaCode %in% filter_areas,
    IndicatorID %in% ind
  ) |>
  droplevels()

# Just data for specific area
area_data <- ind_data |>
  dplyr::filter(AreaCode %in% area_code) |>
  droplevels()

# get lowercase indicator name, keep acronyms in uppercase
ind_name_lc <- unique(area_data$IndicatorNameLC)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# Indicator title and subtitle
cat(paste0("## ", unique(area_data$IndicatorName), "\n\n"))

if (any(!unique(area_data$Sex) %in% "Not applicable") && n_sex == 2) {
  cat(paste0("Male and Female, ", stringr::str_to_lower(unique(area_data$Age))))
} else if (any(!unique(area_data$Sex) %in% "Not applicable")) {
  cat(
    paste0(
      unique(area_data$Sex), ", ", stringr::str_to_lower(unique(area_data$Age))
    )
  )
}
cat("\n")
```

```{r}
#| warnings: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis
# save csv to temp file
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
write.csv(table, f, row.names = FALSE)

# create download link - warnings about deprecated function,
# see https://yihui.org/en/2023/02/xfun-isfalse/ for info
xfun::embed_file(
  f,
  name = paste0(
    stringr::str_replace_all(ind_name_lc, " ", "-"), "-chart-data"
  ),
  text = paste0("Download data on ", ind_name_lc, " in CSV format.")
)

cat(
  paste0(
    "<br><br>See more information about [using CSV file format]",
    "(https://www.gov.uk/guidance/using-csv-file-format)."
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# more information tab
cat("## More information \n\n")
```

```{r}
#| results: "asis"

# select links to fingertips trend and description pages
ind_link_df <- area_data |>
  dplyr::select(
    Sex,
    TrendURL,
    DefinitionURL,
    ProfileURL,
    ProfNameLC,
    IndicatorNameLC
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

if (n_sex == 2) {
  trend_url_m <- ind_link_df |>
    dplyr::filter(Sex %in% "Male") |>
    dplyr::pull(TrendURL)

  trend_url_f <- ind_link_df |>
    dplyr::filter(Sex %in% "Female") |>
    dplyr::pull(TrendURL)

  trend_link <- paste0(
    ind_name_lc, ", male data](", trend_url_m,
    ").\n\n View [", ind_name_lc, ", female data](",
    trend_url_f, ").\n\n"
  )

  def <- ind_link_df |>
    dplyr::slice_head() |>
    dplyr::pull(DefinitionURL)
} else {
  trend_url <- ind_link_df |>
    dplyr::slice_head() |>
    dplyr::pull(TrendURL)

  trend_link <- paste0(ind_name_lc, " data](", trend_url, "). \n\n")

  def <- ind_link_df |>
    dplyr::slice_head() |>
    dplyr::pull(DefinitionURL)
}


# Link to indicator's fingertips pages
cat(
  paste0(
    "You can find more information about this indicator and related data on ",
    "our Fingertips website. Fingertips is a data platform that contains a ",
    " large range of indicators organised into topics, such as tobacco, ",
    "mental health, and mortality.\n\n View [", trend_link
  )
)

# link to metadata
cat(paste0("View the [", ind_name_lc, " definition](", def, ").\n\n"))

# link to profile
profile_url <- ind_link_df |>
  dplyr::slice_head() |>
  dplyr::pull(ProfileURL)

profile_name_lc <- ind_link_df |>
  dplyr::slice_head() |>
  dplyr::pull(ProfNameLC)

cat(
  paste0(
    "Visit the [",
    profile_name_lc,
    "](",
    profile_url,
    ") on Fingertips for more information on ",
    stringr::str_to_lower(params$selected_topic),
    "."
  )
)
```
